mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past three months signals an active monetary easing cycle, reducing the discount rate applied to future corporate earnings and increasing the present value of equities, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of instances despite a declining FEDFUNDS trend, or the Rank IC over any 3-year rolling window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll growth above 200k per month signals strong labor market demand, which supports consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in residential construction starts above 1700k units in a single month signals a surge in housing demand, which acts as a leading indicator of broader consumer confidence and durable goods spending, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX fails to generate positive 60-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 100.0 (2017=100) over two consecutive months indicates weakening manufacturing activity, which reduces corporate profitability expectations and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or the Rank IC over any 2-year window is below 0.03.

failure_condition: SPX fails to produce positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of joint-triggered instances, or the interaction Rank IC over any 3-year window is below 0.03.
